detail_en: Dissertation: **perceived trust** in e-commerce (ISO/IEC 25000), human vs **AI-agent** validation; **inferential stats**—normality checks, **Welch/paired t-tests**, **Cohen's d**, **FDR** (Python → Power BI); descriptive metrics (mean, SD, SE, CI). Coursework (**Grade A in all courses**): Academic Writing, Scientific Research, Innovation & Technology Transfer, **Information Visualization** (visual mapping, multivariate data, interaction, graphs/trees, text viz).

Disciplinas (**nota A**): Escrita Acadêmica, Pesquisa Científica, Inovação, **InfoVis** (mapeamento visual, multivariados, interação, grafos/árvores, viz textos).
